title: An Extension Nobody Can Grant Without Saying Why
description: หน้าจัดการสิทธิ์การใช้งานเปิดใช้แล้ว ค้นลูกค้าจากอีเมลหรือชื่อองค์กร แก้สถานะและวันหมดอายุได้ โดยเหตุผลเป็นช่องบังคับที่ตรวจฝั่งเซิร์ฟเวอร์ก่อนแตะฐานข้อมูล ทุกการเปลี่ยนแปลงเขียน audit event ที่มีองค์กรของลูกค้า ผู้ดำเนินการ สถานะก่อน สถานะหลัง และเหตุผล
scope: add /admin/entitlements: search by member email or organization name, never by project name
edit entitlement state and expiry with a reason that is required on the server, not only in the form
write an audit event per change carrying organization, actor, before, after and reason
repeat the administrator check inside the server action, because an action is its own entry point
return nothing for an empty search, so opening the page is not a request to browse customers
verification: pnpm test 197 passed, 33 skipped; entitlement-admin.test.ts proves the reason and state checks refuse before the database is reached, by mocking getDb to throw
the same suite proves an empty or one-character search returns nothing without querying
browser check on /admin/entitlements?q=test while signed out: refusal renders, zero .admin-card and zero .admin-form in the DOM, and the page text reveals nothing about whether a match exists
pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint pass
rollback: กลับไป tag v0.31.0-admin-scope-and-cards แล้ว revert commit ของ v0.32.0 ไม่มี migration สิทธิ์ที่ถูกแก้ไปแล้วจะคงค่าที่แก้ไว้ แต่มี audit event บันทึกไว้ว่าใครแก้เมื่อไรและเพราะอะไร
constraints: The reason is validated on the server before any write. A rule enforced only by the form is not enforced.
Every admin surface repeats resolvePlatformAdmin. A server action is reachable by anyone who can post to it, whatever guards the page around it.
Customer lookup accepts an email or an organization name and nothing else. A project name identifies a customer too, and ADR 0013 keeps it closed.
An empty search returns an empty result. A back office that lists every customer on load has published the customer list.

Prove by test that an administrator cannot reach a customer's project rows, not merely that the UI hides them
Build the pricing and promotion editors behind the administrator check, writing an audit event per change
Open payment collection: choose a provider, tie a settled invoice to an entitlement state, and write the ADR that governs it
Move the access tier copy out of source and into content the back-office owns
Decide whether trial entitlements issued under the five-day term are migrated to seven days
Show in the estimate where a Factor F came from: printed step or interpolation, and the two steps it sits between
Give the product a way to tell that the Factor F and labour circulars it holds are still the current ones
Bring the ว480 labour rate schedule in as a dataset, keeping the conditions that change a rate (quantity bands, area, method) as data rather than notes
Have a qualified person certify the Factor F dataset and record the name, so pricing can require a reviewed table

Retire takeoff_items.category once headings carry the same meaning
Require a human verification step before any OCR-extracted price or factor can be used in a calculation

Validate the official source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 against the Comptroller General's Department, which ว499 and ว481 confirm is the issuing authority
